title: Fix Full Project Tree Rendering In Cli Tree
description: Implement the `tree <query>e?` command that shows the complete monorepo as a tree with all entity types (projects, bundles, folders, files, sections, definitions, goals, tickets, drafts, policies, statutes, contributors, commits). Add positional query parameter for fuzzy search using bleve. Add `--only-<value>e` and `--no-<filter>e` flags for filtering. Handle parent chain preservation when filtering. Collapse intermediate parents when filtered. Extend existing tests.
summary: Fixed full tree hierarchy rendering by adding folders root category, ensuring bundle-root path inclusion, forcing tree section inclusion, and restructuring policy tree to policy->entitykind->statute. Extended existing tree tests and validated with targeted go test runs.
